# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Cut and paste the text of the record for a failed test into a 
single word document.
3. Do this for water samples with positive bacterial results for the 
same time period.
4. Cut out the details of all the inspection tests performed at the same time.
5. Cut out all data from subsequent tests performed after that date for the same location
6. Paste all of the records together in chronological order
7. Use find and replace to get correct formatting - like replacing the date format. 
8. Remove the header and titles
